summary: The NAND controller and profile-map implementation. Its exports are consumed by owned units; the raw device shape is the remaining seam.

rows.kind: C-ABI bridge between two owned units
rows.removal: both callers link the NAND crate directly and both sides compare with stock in one image

evidence.requirement: The registered mechanism remains required; this unit has no declared produced linked ELF carrying this interface. `xm1_app_nand_*` exports (14 functions in `src/lib.rs`)

rows.shim: NAND register and profile-map layout (`NAND = 0xfff50000`, profile base `0x380`, `src/physical.rs`, `src/memory.rs`)
rows.other_side: the stock raw-NAND clients and the boot-time map that the controller must reproduce
rows.removal: every stock raw-NAND client uses the owned flash layer and the map is initialized by owned startup

evidence.requirement: The registered mechanism remains required; this unit has no declared produced linked ELF carrying this interface. NAND register and profile-map layout (`NAND = 0xfff50000`, profile base `0x380`, `src/physical.rs`, `src/memory.rs`)

rows.shim: `xm1_power_resource_route_request` and the other `xm1_power_*` externs in `src/lib.rs` and `src/dma_native.rs`
rows.kind: C-ABI bridge between two owned units
rows.removal: the leaf is linked directly and both sides compare with stock in one image

rows.other_side: X-M1 core-0 cache and clock/critical leaves
